description: AstraVerify checks whether a domain is trustworthy in the two places that matter today: the inbox and the AI answer. Ask about any domain and it returns two scores out of 100. Email Security covers MX, SPF, DKIM and DMARC, including whether DMARC is actually enforced, and every finding comes with the exact TXT record to paste. Discoverability covers what search engines and AI crawlers can actually get from the site: robots.txt rules for Googlebot, Bingbot, GPTBot, ClaudeBot, OAI-SearchBot and PerplexityBot, whether the CDN blocks them at the edge, the sitemap, www/apex redirects, canonical tags, titles and descriptions, Organization and WebSite structured data, llms.txt, and whether the opening paragraphs define the brand. A fetch-as-crawler tool shows the exact response a named crawler receives, and verify_fix re-checks one area after you change something. Scores are computed by the same rules as astraverify.com, so what the assistant says matches the report page it links to. The server reads public DNS and public pages only, never logs in, never writes to your domain, and needs no account: results are cached and shared, and fresh scans are rate-limited per domain. Built for founders, marketing owners, IT generalists and the agencies that manage many domains.
